audit_correction.correction: Require null ignored framework reset seeds for the fixed optimizer-only seeding producer; physical allocator seeds/order/progress and all other custody checks unchanged.
audit_correction.original_failure: allocator initial framework seed differs from optimizer configuration

closure.physical_replay: cross-bound previously completed replay receipts; not rerun by this auditor

design.delivery_array_encoding: Per-seed arrays follow the 28 ordered schedule entries exactly; null means no recorded settlement, including stopped prefixes.

projection_contract.residual_extras: zero raw action and exact-zero original command are required; full residual evidence is raw-digest-validated and already cross-bound to completed detached replay
projection_contract.retained: all physical/public-observation/manifest/command authority/target/allocation/guard/plant/minute/economic/safety/settlement fields, including all unrelated hashes

initial_residual_mpc_equivalence.scope: complete physical equality after explicit MPC wall-clock/provenance rehash projection; original saved commands are separately bound by physical replay; no partial-prefix match claim

definitions.action_clipping: Gaussian probability outside residual [-1,1] and observed sample clipping are separate. Evaluation actions are deterministic stored outputs.
definitions.association: Pooled and per-seed Pearson correlations and fault strata are descriptive serially correlated observations; no tests, causal feature importance, quantile benefit, or fault-recovery effectiveness is inferred.
definitions.authority: E nominal>1200kW, or downstream nominal>0. An upper cap can remove positive but retain negative authority. All zero nominal targets and E<=floor remain fixed. Exact positive counts and counts above 1e-9 kW are both retained; this tolerance identifies floating-point dust, not operational materiality.
definitions.diagnostic_timing: Diagnostic k precedes optimizer update k. Diagnostic 4 is not post-final-optimizer critic/exploration measurement.
definitions.gradient_sample: First 256 env-major-then-time rollout entries, pre-update; not actual shuffled SGD minibatches.
definitions.hold_target_kwh: Command kW multiplied by 0.25 h; requested target exposure, not actual applied energy, costs, generation or savings.
definitions.ppo_ratio_clipping: Post-update optimizer ledger clip_fraction concerns likelihood ratios, not action bounds.
definitions.scalar_constraints: Null cost critics/components, zero multipliers and mechanical multiplier_saturated flags do not indicate active constraint learning.
definitions.target_delta: Issued target minus cached MPC command at exactly the same policy-visited state, not a causal comparison to the independent native MPC trajectory.

limitations: Four rollout collections and one optimizer seed cannot establish convergence, stability across seeds, or algorithm superiority.
Training rollout return sums combine different episodes and partial episodes; they are not a fixed-scenario learning curve.
Pre-update diagnostics do not measure the critic or Gaussian standard deviations after the last optimization.
Deterministic action variation and forecast correlations do not demonstrate causal use or benefit of forecast quantiles.
MPC prior uses public forecast means; policy states and derived targets share common causes, including time of day, inventories and faults.
Mapped target differences are intended authority; actual applied energy and paired operational effects belong to the separate operational diagnosis.
learning_diagnosis.scope: All four saved pre-optimization diagnostics, all four post-update optimizer ledger rows, and all eight complete final-policy development episodes. One optimizer seed, adaptive development, no convergence or held-out claim.

limits: One optimizer seed 101 and eight adaptive development cases. No held-out, site-generalization, commercial or algorithm-level claim.
No arm is selected or declared an operational winner. No materiality or confirmation threshold is chosen after outcomes.
Full-panel aggregates and paired differences require all eight complete and replayed episodes. Failed/stopped/null slots remain visible and cannot produce subset wins.
Economic differences must be read with per-case service, strict safety including forced stops, and every daily four-resource deficit; a favorable mean alone is insufficient.
The initial residual-versus-OperatingMPC check is the auditor's per-case full physical projection equivalence, not equality of an average performance number.
Cached MPC targets are causal derived inputs. The residual mapping preserves low-power and zero nominal commands, but future energy/inventory effects may still violate service, resources or safety.
All four diagnostic and optimizer ledger rows are retained for completed training; failed training retains every available prefix and no replacement arm or initialization.

Gaussian action-bound clipping, PPO probability-ratio clipping and common gradient clipping are distinct quantities. Diagnostic gradients are not actual shuffled SGD gradients or Adam parameter updates.
All optimizer rewards use 0.001 times EUR. Unit-restored rewards/MSE do not undo float32 rounding, visited-state differences or different bootstrapped targets; evaluated economics stay raw EUR.
Scalar cost-critic diagnostics remain null, not zero physical violations. Raw constraint ledger costs are retained for every learner.
Physical replay does not itself prove the checkpoint generated saved actions or authenticate a comparator exception; process/checkpoint/source custody is separate.
Observed differences in forecasts, outages or recovery are descriptive. Correlation does not establish which feature caused a policy outcome.

strict_paired_noninferiority.scope: Exact directional checks, without a fitted tolerance or material-benefit claim; passing them does not select a policy or authorize confirmation.

limits: Recorded paired development behavior; no reset, inference, replay, retraining, new selection or materiality rule.
Economic components are exact ledger decomposition; behavioral mechanisms are descriptive and do not isolate a causal RL feature.
Recovery is a solved MPC mode addressing current/projected stock deficits; only fallback records absence of a plan.
MPC prior changes on the policy's changed state. Cross-policy target differences are not pure residual-action effects.
All eight pairs,224 deliveries and56 daily resource vectors are retained for each required comparison.

clipping_definitions.common_gradient_clip: pre-update diagnostic implied common actor/reward-critic gradient clipping; not actual shuffled SGD gradients or Adam parameter updates
clipping_definitions.gaussian_action_bounds: Gaussian action-coordinate probability or observed sample outside [-1, 1], before environment action clipping; pre-update fixed diagnostic sample
clipping_definitions.ppo_ratio_clip_fraction: optimizer minibatch fraction whose policy probability ratio leaves the PPO ratio-clip band; this is not action saturation

A-mpc-residual-scalar.scalar_cost_semantics: Raw ledger constraint totals remain physical evidence. Scalar cost-critic diagnostic fields remain null; ledger cost-value/multiplier placeholders do not establish learned cost critics or zero physical deficits.

units.critic_mse_eur_squared: MSE divided by 0.001 squared; unit conversion only, with potentially different visited states and bootstrapped targets
units.optimizer_rewards: raw interval EUR multiplied by 0.001 before rollout-buffer float32 storage
units.rollout_reward_eur_equivalent: unit-rescaled optimizer reward sum; not a replacement for the physical raw-EUR ledger
